name: Silent Numbers
source:
Buried deep underground, Jada is subjected to cruel experiments. After surgery, she wakes with memories that aren’t her own – and a voice inside urges her forward. 

Uncover fragments of the past to survive the present.

[From [url=https://studio-t12.itch.io/silent-numbers-chapter-1-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
贾达被埋在地下深处，接受着残酷的实验。手术后，她醒来时带着不属于自己的记忆——内心有一个声音催促她前进。

揭开过去的碎片，才能在现在生存。

[来自[url=https://studio-t12.itch.io/silent-numbers-chapter-1-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
